packageRules.description: Markdown tooling moves together — prettier, markdownlint, and cspell gate the same checks, so review them in one PR.
Action digest bumps are mechanical and the workflows re-run on the PR, so they need no staged rollout.

The root workspace and xtask/ are this repository's own dependencies: the checks compile against them, so a bot bump is exactly the mechanical change Renovate should make, and CI re-runs every check on its PR.

Everything under templates/ is CONTENT, not this repository's dependencies: the crate pins in templates/Cargo.toml, the toolchain in templates/rust-toolchain.toml, and the rust-version fields. They are maintained by the refresh-rust-versions skill, which resolves each pin against crates.io, checks the MSRV, reads release notes on a major bump, and updates the template's header comment. A bot bumping the version string alone would satisfy none of that while leaving the header wrong, and audit-freshness would stop being able to tell a reviewed pin from an unreviewed one.
